question: After exact per-mutation source validation is fixed, should production repair mutation adopt the Administration-scoped ruleset verifier and four-stage receipt-bound publication boundary?
rationale: The stale-authorization defect has a mechanical repair, but changing App permissions and the trusted production mutation architecture requires explicit maintainer authorization.

options.title: Fix and stage rollout
options.body: Repair the guard, land with production mutation disabled, prove blocked and successful paths, and then enable the verifier permission.

options.title: Defer privileged finalization
options.body: Keep the staged-proof infrastructure while leaving merge-capable publication disabled pending a narrower approval follow-up.

recommendation.title: Fix and stage rollout
recommendation.body: Repair the guard, land with production mutation disabled, prove blocked and successful paths, and then enable the verifier permission.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the current redesign and is best positioned to coordinate its code repair and rollout decision with the long-term repair-lane owner.
